name: EventON Lite
notes: Loads EventON's scripts and styles only on pages that show a calendar or event, instead of on every page, and stops loading its Google Fonts, so visitors' browsers do not contact Google. Calendars then show Poppins and Noto Sans only where the visitor has them installed, and a plain sans-serif font elsewhere.

evcal_options_evcal_1.evo_load_scripts_o.label: Load eventON scripts and styles only on eventON pages
evcal_options_evcal_1.evo_load_scripts_o.description: Loads EventON’s scripts, styles and Google Maps only on pages with a calendar.

evcal_options_evcal_1.evo_googlefonts.label: Disable google web fonts
evcal_options_evcal_1.evo_googlefonts.description: Stops loading the Google fonts EventON’s calendar uses.
